item.title: Endangered giant burrowing frog returns to wild after tadpoles rescued from ashes of black summer fires
item.description: Tadpoles collected from puddles in East Gippsland were transported to Melbourne zoo, where they were raised to metamorphosis and successfully bred in captivity for the first time After the 2019-20 black summer bushfires , scientists in eastern Victoria stumbled across something they had been after for years: puddles of tadpoles from the southern giant burrowing frog, one of the state’s most cryptic amphibians. The fires had torn through extensive areas in East Gippsland, sparking concerns for the survival of the frog, which is considered critically endangered in Victoria. Continue reading... item.description: An Indonesian military helicopter carrying eight people on a firefighting mission crashed in waters off Borneo island on Wednesday, killing a crew member, the army said. The Southeast Asian archipelago has for months been struggling to control wildfires that have burned through large swathes of Sumatra, Borneo and Papua islands, causing choking haze that drifted to neighbouring Malaysia, East Timor and Singapore. The helicopter took off on Wednesday morning from Seruyan district in Borneo’s... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Canva anuncia una reestructuración drástica de su plantilla con 1.200 trabajadores afectados, un 22% de su plantilla
item.description: Canva está reorganizando su estructura, y eso va a afectar a unas 1.271 personas de la empresa, lo que supone un 22% de la plantilla. Del total, muchos verán su puesto de trabajo modificado o trasladado, pero otros tantos serán despedidos. Melanie Perkins, CEO de la compañía, emitió el comunicado tanto a sus trabajadores como en su web, calificando el movimiento como “el momento más difícil de nuestros trece años de historia”. La empresa no ha indicado cuántos de todos ellos acabarán perdiendo su empleo. Por qué importa. Canva es una de las empresas emergentes más conocidas de Australia y… Fuente: Xataka.
